issues: Both pages were grey wireframe placeholder dashboards with no content or text, so nothing told you what changed
On the light grey page the hand was a thin grey line; even four stroke layers barely read as light
The hand appeared at full speed from the centre and stopped dead at 12 o'clock: no spin-up, no inertia
The layout ignored the wipe's pivot: the centre fell into a gap between cards, so the sweep just sliced the image
changes: Dark midnight look; the two pages are the same network-ops screen in a stale state (desaturated, "Synced 6 days ago") and a live state (electric blue, green deltas, "Live"), so the wipe reads as a data refresh
Composition built around the pivot: a 500px throughput dial with a 60-tick bezel (the clock face) at centre, two big 88px metric cards on each side
The hand grows out of the dial rim: white core, layered electric-blue glow and a 55° afterglow fan; the dial arc charges to 78% as the hand passes and its end cap lights up
Hand motion: 6f spin-up, then a constant 8°/frame for a 48f sweep, and after the clip is removed it coasts another 40° while fading
Both pages share one stage background so there is no seam at 12 o'clock; the live bloom powers on after the sweep, followed by a Live ping, a rising delta tag and a ticking clock during the hold
